item.title: Badly overgrown prickly hedge obstructing well used alley, 28th September
item.description:
The alley way/walkway between The Nurseries and Meadoway in Bishops Cleeve is severely restricted by badly overgrown prickly hedges. This footpath is well used by small children, school children, pushchairs and the elderly and it is becoming unusable and impassable because of severely overhanging prickly hedgerow. It is clear that no one has cut the hedges for ages.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): The Nurseries, Bishop's Cleeve, Tewkesbury
